about: The fortress's recipes (round 128l, m4: fortress slice 1, milestone 4; docs/design/FORTRESS_SLICE1.md, FORTRESS_MODE.md 'Recipes'). A structure type turns goods into goods (craft) or a person and goods into a unit (train), a batch at a time: `in` is taken out of the stores when a worker fetches it and carried to the structure, `seconds` is the work there, `out` goes back to the stores (craft) or stands up as the unit (train: the person is that unit now). src/fortress/recipes.ts runs them. Untuned: the user tunes once it's playable.
